QuestInfo.name: The Secret Recipe
QuestInfo.0: You perform a favor for #Robby Fray#k so he would agree to cater the party, but when you go to turn it in, he screams in dismay. It seems like you'll have to do him another favor...
QuestInfo.1: The recipe is lost?! Find it quick, before somebody spills the secret!\nHunt the Doll Claws on the #r3rd-4th Floors of Kerning Square#k. The recipe might be around there.\n
QuestInfo.2: Whew! Finally, you convinced Robby Fray, the seven star chef, to cater the party. Report the good news to #bLana#k.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 7,950\nCan proceed to the Reception Party Preparation, Done! quest\n

0.0: Oh no! If this secret is leaked... I can't even bear to think of it. Hey, you there! Don't just stand there, I need your help!

yes.0: I lost my secret recipe! It was sooo yummy and now everybody's going to find out! I think I lost it when I was playing the Doll Claw game on the #r3rd - 4th Floors of Kerning  Square#k. Please, please find it! I'll go out of business if this gets out!

no.0: If I don't find my Secret Recipe, there is no way I can continue living, let alone cater #bBlake#k's party...

1.0: Oh, please tell me you found my Secret Recipe! Please!

yes.0: Oh, thank goodness! That's it! Oh, my precious recipe, my baby. Thank you so much. I will take care of Blake's party as promised. Don't worry about a thing. It'll be magnificent. Please let #bLana#k the CEO of Big Hit Records know.

item.0: Take the escalator to the 3rd-4th floor of the Shopping Center. When you get there, defeat the Dolls and bring me back my precious #b#t4032508##k! I beg you!
